start_hint: Give /help a burl to learn the ropes, /language to change ya yak, eh.

help_flow: How she works, eh 1. Chuck a manga/ranobe title at me, plain text. 2. Pick the right one off the buttons (I hunt through titles and alt-titles in every yak). 3. Take ya pick: last 10 chapters, a range, volume(s) or just the one, eh. 4. I'll bung it in the queue and flick the archive(s) right back here, sweet as. Keep tabs with /queue and /status, pull the pin with /cancel, bro.
help_zip_how: What to do with the .ZIP / .CBZ, eh • Yeah nah, it's just a ZIP full of page pics. .cbz = .zip with a flash name — rename it either way, she'll be right. • Chuck it in Mihon, CDisplayEx, Perfect Viewer, YACReader — or just unzip her and flick through, easy as. • Ranobe (novels) rock up as .epub — any e-reader will scoff those, chur.
help_zip_why: Why ZIP, ya reckon? A volume's heaps of pages, bro — hundreds, eh! One file beats 300 piccies spamming your chat — kinder to Telegram's limits and kinder on ya eyeballs. 😉
help_pack: Packing modes (flick 'em in /settings, eh) • Merged (the default, choice): whole volume, one archive, pages numbered straight through. • Per-chapter: one archive with N separate chapter files inside, mean. Single chapters always rock up as one file, sweet as. Telegram caps files at {mb} MB — chunkier volumes get chopped into labelled parts, good as gold.
